scope: Theorem 2.1 (Normalized Gaussian Fourier pair) of the manuscript “Universal optimality of the triangular lattice” (preprints/Universal-optimality-of-the-triangular-lattice-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 090 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 50daa477c52b1f3e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite real k ≥ 2.36, put Tk(s) = k−1e−k(s−1). There are entire functions H1, H2, real on the real axis, and a real radial Schwartz function f on R2 such that f(x) = e−πhb|x|2 H1(b |x|2 ), b f(ξ) = e−πhb|ξ|2 H2(b |ξ|2 ). For every real s ≥ 0, H1(s) ≤ Tk(s), H2(s) ≥ 0. (2.3) At every n ∈ N, the values and first derivatives satisfy H1(n) = Tk(n), H′ 1(n) = T′ k(n) = −e−k(n−1) , H2(n) = H′ 2(n) = 0. (2.4)
